prompt: Choose the best word or sentence for blank [137].
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入第 137 題空格的字詞或句子。

options.text: the coordinator’s request, made before she travelled, that she attend in person
options.zh: 協調員在她搭車前要求她到場出席的通知
options.whyZh: 規則問實際前往是否由協調員要求；後續通知已在搭車前將到場改為必要。

options.text: the booking that was already in place when the coordinator wrote
options.zh: 協調員寫信時就已訂好的行程
options.whyZh: 車已訂好證明訂位早，不表示當時搭車是否受要求。

options.text: the attendance choice stated in the first invitation
options.zh: 第一封邀請上列的出席選項
options.whyZh: 最初邀請可以選擇，但已被隨後的現場展示要求改變。

options.text: the reason she was originally considering the morning bus
options.zh: 她原先考慮搭早班車的理由
options.whyZh: 搭車前的最終要求決定工時；沒有證據說她先選客運的理由會影響工時。

explanationZh: 規則問實際前往是否由協調員要求；後續通知已在搭車前將到場改為必要。

vocabulary.note: 此處與參加線上場次對照，in person 修飾出席的方式。

evidence: A trip to the workshop counts as work time when a coordinator has asked the apprentice to attend in person. / The next day the coordinator asked her to present a physical sample, so she needed to come in. / She took the same bus she had already booked.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: A trip to the workshop counts as work time when a coordinator has asked the apprentice to attend in person.
The next day the coordinator asked her to present a physical sample, so she needed to come in.
She took the same bus she had already booked.
